common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
common.passwordLong: The password exceeds the 256-byte limit. Use a shorter one.

roleHelp.admin: Configures everything, including users and audit.
roleHelp.auditor: Views the panel and the audit log, without acting.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who accesses the panel and with which role
users.forbidden: Only administrators manage users. Ask an administrator if someone needs access.
users.usernameHint: 2 to 64 characters: unaccented letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore or at sign.
users.usernameInvalid: Use 2 to 64 characters: unaccented letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore or at sign.
users.displayNameHint: Optional. Shown in the panel and in the audit log.
users.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. You will hand this password to the person; they can change it in Settings.
users.mfaNotice: Administrators and operators set up the second factor on first sign-in.
users.confirmCreateImpact: The account is created with the {{role}} role and can sign in right away with the initial password.
users.createdWarning: This is the only time the initial password is shown. Hand it over through a secure channel and ask the person to change it after the first sign-in.
users.createdMfa: On first sign-in, the person sets up the second factor in an authenticator app.
users.createdDone: I have handed over the password
users.empty: No users found. Create the first one with the Create user button.
users.disabledHint: The person cannot sign in while access is disabled. Their data stays in the panel.
users.lastAdminHint: This is the only enabled administrator: it cannot be demoted, disabled or removed. Create another administrator first.
users.lastAdminError: This change would leave the panel without an enabled administrator. Create another administrator first.
users.selfDeleteHint: You cannot remove your own user.
users.impactSessions: This person's open sessions will be ended and they must sign in again.
users.impactSelf: You will also be signed out and must sign in again.
users.impactNameOnly: The new name shows in the panel and in upcoming audit entries.
users.confirmResetMfaImpact: This person's second factor and recovery codes are erased and their open sessions ended. On the next sign-in they set up the authenticator app again.
users.confirmDeleteImpact: The account is deleted and this person's open sessions are ended. Their audit entries remain recorded.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.subtitle: Access for automations and scripts
tokens.allUsers: As an administrator, you see every user's tokens.
tokens.ownOnly: You only see the tokens you created.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHint: Say where the token will be used, for example "Zabbix monitoring". Up to 64 characters.
tokens.nameRequired: Enter a name of up to 64 characters.
tokens.roleHint: Your own role or read-only. Give the smallest role the automation needs.
tokens.daysHint: From 1 to 365 days. After that the token stops working.
tokens.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 365.
tokens.confirmCreateImpact: Whoever holds the token acts in the panel with the {{role}} role for {{count}} days, until it is revoked.
tokens.createdWarning: Copy the token now. It will not be shown again: the panel only keeps a fingerprint of it. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.
tokens.usageHeader: Send the token in the header of each request:
tokens.usageLimit: Tokens cannot confirm a password: actions that require re-authentication (users, exceptions, resource profiles, token creation) can only be done in the panel.
tokens.empty: No tokens created. Create a token to connect scripts and monitoring to the panel.
tokens.confirmRevokeImpact: Automations using this token stop working immediately and receive an authentication error.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what in the panel, most recent first
audit.forbidden: Only administrators and auditors can view the audit log.
audit.chainOk: Chain intact: no entry was changed or removed.
audit.chainBroken: Chain broken from entry #{{id}}: records may have been changed or removed outside the panel.
audit.chainBrokenUnknown: Chain broken: records may have been changed or removed outside the panel.
audit.chainBrokenAction: Keep a copy of the VigiaHost database before any fix and investigate access to the server.
audit.filterScope: The filter applies to the entries already loaded. Load older entries to widen the search.
audit.end: Reached the beginning of the audit log.
audit.empty: No entries recorded yet. Actions taken in the panel show up here.
audit.noMatch: No loaded entry matches the filter. Clear the filter or load older entries.

actions.password_reset_with_token: Reset password with a terminal token
actions.reset_token_issued: Issued a password reset token in the terminal

account.settingsSubtitle: Your account and this browser's preferences
account.title: Your account
account.name: Name
account.recoveryLow: Few recovery codes left. If they run out and you lose the authenticator app, ask an administrator to reset your second factor.
account.passwordIntro: Changing the password ends your other open sessions; this one stays active. API tokens are not affected.
account.newHint: At least 12 characters. A long phrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.
account.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one.
account.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were ended.
account.tokensIntro: To connect scripts and monitoring, create tokens with the smallest role needed.

backup.title: Database backup
backup.subtitle: Copies of the panel database: users, findings, runs, schedules and audit log
backup.confirmObject: Panel database (consistent copy, service stays up)
backup.confirmImpact: The copy is stored in the server's backup directory and is not removed by automatic retention. It contains sensitive data (users, audit log and findings): protect the directory like the database itself.
backup.retention_one: The service makes one automatic copy per day and keeps the latest; manual copies and those made before upgrading or restoring stay until deleted on the server.
backup.retention_other: The service makes one automatic copy per day and keeps the latest {{count}}; manual copies and those made before upgrading or restoring stay until deleted on the server.
backup.empty: The first automatic copy is made a few minutes after the service starts. You can also make one now.
backup.restoreIntro: Restoring replaces the whole database, so it is not done from the panel. On the server, as root:
backup.restoreSafety: The command checks the copy's integrity, refuses copies from a newer VigiaHost version and keeps the current database as a "Before restore" copy so you can go back. Running scans are interrupted when the service stops.
backup.retention_zero: The service makes one automatic copy per day and keeps the latest {{count}}; manual copies and those made before upgrading or restoring stay until deleted on the server.
